import asyncio,grpc,json,sys
mode=sys.argv[1]
def event(stage,**values):print(json.dumps(dict(stage=stage,**values)),flush=True)
async def main():
 server=grpc.aio.server()
 port=server.add_insecure_port('127.0.0.1:0')
 assert port>0
 await server.start()
 waiter=asyncio.create_task(server.wait_for_termination())
 stop_event=asyncio.Event()
 if mode=='event':
  import signal
  asyncio.get_running_loop().add_signal_handler(signal.SIGINT,lambda:(event('signal_received'),stop_event.set()))
 await asyncio.sleep(.1)
 event('ready',port=port,mode=mode)
 try:
  if mode=='event':await stop_event.wait()
  elif mode=='shield':await asyncio.shield(waiter)
  else:await waiter
 except asyncio.CancelledError:
  event('cancelled',cancelling=asyncio.current_task().cancelling(),waiter_cancelled=waiter.cancelled())
 event('stop_begin')
 try:await server.stop(.1)
 except BaseException as error:
  event('stop_error',error=type(error).__name__)
  raise
 event('stop_end')
 await waiter
 event('waiter_end')
asyncio.run(main())
